exposure: care setting (Haemophilia Treatment Centres (HTCs) vs. non-HTCs)
outcome: periprocedural VWD-specific therapy use per NHLBI guidelines
cohort: The study included adult patients with von Willebrand disease (VWD) who underwent an invasive procedure between 2015 and 2017.
finding: Haemophilia Treatment Centres (HTCs) demonstrated significantly higher adherence to VWD-specific therapy guidelines and were more likely to have procedural estimated blood loss ≥ 100 ml, but showed no difference in post-procedure bleeding compared to non-HTCs.
